# Larrot

> Larrot repeats Huawei Cloud. A local Huawei Cloud API simulator:
> LocalStack, but for Huawei Cloud. 66 services, 738 operations,
> Apache-2.0, no account required.

Larrot runs the Huawei Cloud REST and OBS APIs on localhost so you can
develop and test cloud clients, IaC, and coding agents without an
account, latency, or a bill. Official SDKs and the Terraform provider
work unchanged.

## Quickstart

```bash
pip install larrot
larrot-server          # REST on :8200, OBS on :8201
```

Point any Huawei SDK at `http://127.0.0.1:8200` with AK
`HWYSIMAK00000001` / SK `HWYSIMSK00000001`, or use the GitHub Action
(`larbi-ishak/Larrot@v1`), or `larrot proxy` for zero client config.

- [Contributing](https://larbi-ishak.github.io/Larrot/contributing/): adding services and operations

## Admin platform

- `POST /admin/reset` — wipe all state, server keeps running
- `POST /admin/seed?a=42` — deterministic resource IDs
- `GET /admin/requests` — request journal (what the client actually sent)
- `PUT /admin/state/{rid}` — force any resource state instantly
- `POST /admin/chaos` — inject failures per service
- `larrot mcp` — all of the above as MCP tools for coding agents
- `SIM_IAM=enforce` — reject unsigned requests with real APIGW errors
- `SIM_PERSIST=1` — keep state across restarts
